description: List every calculator with its id, modes and input fields. Pass calculator=<id> to also get field hints and an example input. Call this before run_calculator.

calculator.description: Optional: only show this calculator id.

language.description: Language of the steps: nl (Dutch, default) or en (English).

name: list_calculators
title: List calculators

description: Run one calculator (ids from list_calculators) with explicit inputs and return the answer with worked steps. Field types: number (JSON number, or a string such as '2,5' or '-3'), fraction ({"n":3,"d":4} or '3/4'), list (array of numbers or '4; 7; 9'), text (a formula string such as 'x^3 - 2x'). Calculators with units accept inputs.unit (e.g. 'cm').

language.description: Language of the steps: nl (Dutch, default) or en (English).

mode.description: Mode id of that calculator (see list_calculators). Defaults to the first mode.

name: run_calculator
title: Run a calculator

description: Solve a short maths question written in Dutch or English and return the answer with worked steps. Understands quadratic and linear equations, percentages, fractions, Pythagoras, derivatives, exponential growth, normal distribution, GCD/LCM, division with remainder, scale and plain arithmetic (e.g. '2^10 + sqrt(16)'). If the question is not understood, it says so and suggests the closest topics; it never guesses.

language.description: Language of the steps: nl (Dutch, default) or en (English).

question.description: The question, e.g. 'los op 2x + 3 = 11' or 'what is 15% of 80'.

name: solve_math_question
title: Solve a maths question
